parsed.summary: The PR introduces a micro-optimization by avoiding the instantiation of MaxLengthValidator when max_length is None. It also aligns with the initialization process of BinaryField.

issues.description: The PR does not include any new tests to verify the behavior of Value._resolve_output_field() with the modified CharField.__init__ method.

The change introduces a conditional check for max_length, which slightly deviates from the direct initialization seen in BinaryField. While this is minor, it could be worth considering aligning the two for consistency.
